CREATE TABLE "public"."barista" (
  "address" text,
  "birthDate" timestamptz,
  "city" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "emergencyContactName" text,
  "emergencyContactPhone" text,
  "employeeNumber" text NOT NULL,
  "employmentStatus" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  "gender" text,
  "hireDate" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "position" text NOT NULL,
  "postalCode" text,
  "province" text,
  "resignationDate" timestamptz,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "barista_employmentStatus_check_fc49f77b" CHECK ("employmentStatus" IN ('ACTIVE', 'INACTIVE')),
  CONSTRAINT "barista_gender_check_9e8dd636" CHECK ("gender" IN ('MALE', 'FEMALE'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."customer" (
  "birthDate" timestamptz,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "gender" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "customer_gender_check_9e8dd636" CHECK ("gender" IN ('MALE', 'FEMALE'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."customerAddress" (
  "address" text NOT NULL,
  "city" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "customerId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "isDefault" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "label" text NOT NULL,
  "latitude" numeric,
  "longitude" numeric,
  "phone" text NOT NULL,
  "postalCode" text,
  "province" text NOT NULL,
  "recipientName" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."user" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "firebaseUid" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "phone" text,
  "profilePhoto" text,
  "role" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "user_role_check_e59290cb" CHECK ("role" IN ('ADMIN', 'CUSTOMER', 'BARISTA', 'GUEST')),
  CONSTRAINT "user_status_check_6939929a" CHECK ("status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'INACTIVE', 'BLOCKED'))
)
